title: SQLite
label: SQLite
checked: Expression pipelines, grouped windows, counts, and joins on a SQLite table through Phibble\tbl(). Results compared with DataFrame or with expected values; lazy evaluation in SQL and the in-memory fallback for closures.
description: tests/SqlTest.php loads panel.csv into an in-memory SQLite database, runs each pipeline on the SQLite table and on DataFrame, and checks the class of each result. Values compared is the number of assertions in a case; a case fails if any assertion fails.
reference: phplyr on phibble's DataFrame, and expected values in the tests

inputs.name: panel.csv
inputs.detail: 12 rows: id, g, year, value, score, label. Loaded into an in-memory SQLite database with declared column types.

comparison.applies_to: Column names, row counts and order, strings, integers, booleans, dates, and missing values

cases.name: Keeps expression pipelines lazy and matches the in-memory result
Runs grouped windows, counts and joins in SQL
Falls back to memory for closures
Accepts Phibble\Expr nodes directly and stays lazy
